Presses the formed fiber mold can run on. Drives the 'Machine – Brand and Model' dropdown in the design-to-process handoff tool. Reloaded on every run -- edits take effect without restarting the tool.

This library holds NAMES ONLY, plus a characterization flag. It deliberately does not carry vacuum pressure or pressing force: those are set per run, not per press, so there is no value to remember against a machine. They are typed on the form every time. Do not re-add pressure keys here -- they would be read as machine constants and overwrite what was just entered.

What it is for: keeping the press named identically on every document (no 'KFT90' / 'KFT 90' / 'KFT-90' drift), and flagging a press that has not been characterized yet.

'characterized': false means the press has not been characterized. The tool still generates the handoff, but shows a warning, because the document states that an uncharacterized machine must be characterized before the first production run. Absent means true. A quoted "false" also counts as false -- bool("false") is True in Python, and a safety warning must not vanish because of a pair of quotes.

A machine with no 'name' is skipped -- it could not be picked from the dropdown.
